name: proto-bridge
description: Prototype-to-implementation context bridge for AI-assisted migration specs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/core build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/cli build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/mcp-server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/mcp-server typecheck
scripts.example:flutter: cd examples/vue3-to-flutter/target-flutter && flutter build web && python3 -m http.server 5599 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory build/web
